out_items.name: Proper cooling time and temperature

violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: - OBSERVED: pooled eggs (43f) was stored in perlick 2-door cooler for about 4.5 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM discarded the pooled eggs.

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: - OBSERVED: rehydrated glass noodles (58f) were stored on cook line for about 4.5 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM discarded the glass noodles. Gogi Friends (Inspection Date: 09/14/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the back door.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM has obtained the materials to fill the gaps.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: - OBSERVED: (1) rice scoops were stored in a container of stagnant water at 80f. (2) knives and a knife sharpener were stored between equipment.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS educated the CFM and food employees. CFM relocated the knives and knife sharpener.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment Components, Adjusted per Manufacturer
violations.observation: The door gaskets of the following unit(s) are damaged: True 2-door display cooler (right unit) and avantco 2-door prep cooler (bar).
violations.corrective_action: Equipment components such as doors, seals, hinges, fasteners, and kick plates shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted in accordance with manufacturer's specifications. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM will replace the gaskets.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Chemical Sanitizing, Contact Time Met
violations.observation: EHS observed the concentration of chlorine in the chemical dish machine at 10ppm.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dischmachine so that food contact surfaces are exposed to sanitizer for the required amount of time per the data plate. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food contact surfaces. PIC SET UP THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: observed logs not filled out or incorrectly filled out for sides, hot bar and boba.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. PIC FILLED OUT AND CORRECTED LOGS.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: observed raw beef thawing on the counter
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE PUT BEEF IN THE WALK IN.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observed utensils stored in water
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC DUMPED WATER OUT.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Reminder
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without a reminder statement: observed the reminder statement missing from the menu.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, all Spanish speaking kitchen staff have not acknowledged, read or signed the Employee Illness Reporting Agreement.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. EHS SENT VIA EMAIL SPANISH EMPLOYEE ILLNESS FORMS FOR SIGNATURE BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS SENT VIA EMAIL THE WRITTEN VOMITING/DIARRHEA POLICY IN BOTH ENGLISH AND SPANISH.

violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF THAT PERSONAL BEVERAGES SHALL BE COVERED AND CONSUMED THROUGH A STRAW OR CLOSED TYPE LID. ENSURE STAFF ARE TRAINED BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures. Staff member was observed rinsing his hands; did not use soap.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER TO RE-WASH HIS HANDS USING SOAP. EHS ALSO EMAILED A FACT SHEET ON HAND WASHING IN BOTH KOREAN AND SPANISH. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction by Freezing
violations.observation: No records of freezing for parasite destruction are maintained for the following raw, raw marinated, partially cooked or marinated-partially cooked fish that are served or sold in ready-to-eat form: 1) SHRIMP, 2) OCTOPUS, 3) SQUID. FOODS COOKED BY THE CONSUMER AT THE KOREAN BBQ.
violations.corrective_action: If raw or partially cooked fish are served or sold in ready-to-eat form, the person in charge shall record the freezing temperature and time to which the fish are subjected and shall retain the records for the frozen fish at the food establishment for 90 calendar days beyond the time of service or sale to a consumer. If the fish are frozen by a supplier, a letter the fish supplier stipulating that the fish is frozen as required shall be provided. EHS INSTRUCTED THE GENERAL MANAGER TO CONTACT THEIR SEAFOOD VENDOR AND OBTAIN THE REQUIRED PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER SHOWING THE SHRIMP, OCTOPUS, AND SQUID ARE FROZEN SPECIFICALLY BY THE 2017 FDA FOOD CODE. ENSURE THE LETTER IS PROVIDED BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) RAW ANIMAL PROTEINS SUCH RAW EGGS, RAW PORK, RAW SEAFOOD, RAW BEEF, AND RAW CHICKEN WERE FOUND STORED ABOVE SAUCES, TOFU, VEGETABLES, COOKED FOODS, ETC INSIDE MULTIPLE REFRIGERATION UNITS IN THE MAIN KITCHEN AND OPEN KITCHEN AREAS.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF ON HOW TO PROPERLY SEPARATE OUT RAW ANIMAL PROTEINS FROM OTHER FOOD STORAGE AND ORGANIZE THE SHELVING UNITS (IF NEEDED) BY THE RAW ANIMAL PROTEIN COOK TEMPERATURE. ENSURE TRAINING AND CONTINUED CORRECTION TO STAFF BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: 1) PREPARED AND/OR COOKED FOODS ARE NOT DATE MARKED. THIS INCLUDES FOODS LIKE COOKED MEATS, COOKED VEGETABLES, KIMCHI, ETC.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF THAT ANY FOODS STORED IN A REFRIGERATOR FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS THAT IS ALREADY PREPARED/COOKED SHALL BE LABELED AND DATED. SEE THE FACT SHEET IN BOTH KOREAN AND SPANISH ON DATE MARKING. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

ALL FOODS SHALL BE DISPENSED USING FOOD SCOOPS OR UTENSILS DESIGNED WITH HANDLES. THE HANDLE WILL SIT UP, OUT OF THE FOOD AT ALL TIMES. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF AND CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: Clean stainless steel bowls on a shelf in the kitchen were observed stored with the food-contact surface facing upward.
violations.corrective_action: Clean equipment and utensils shall be stored in a self-draining position that allows air drying and covered/inverted. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER TO TURN THE BOWLS THAT ARE IN STORAGE UPSIDE DOWN. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Equip/Utensils/Linens, Prohibited Storage Areas
violations.observation: Clean equipment/utensils were found stored in the employee restroom.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned and sanitized equipment, utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items may not be stored in: 1) locker rooms, 2) toilet rooms, 3) garbage rooms, 4) mechanical rooms, 5) under sewer lines that are not shielded to intercept potential drips, 6) under leaking water lines including leaking automatic fire sprinkler heads or under lines on which water has condensed, 7) under open stairwells, or 8) under other sources of contamination. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER TO REMOVE THE CLEAN SQUEEZE BOTTLES FROM THE EMPLOYEE RESTROOM. ENSURE STAFF ARE TRAINED THAT NOTHING SHALL BE IN THE EMPLOYEE RESTROOM BUT CLEANING SUPPLIES, ETC.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed boxes of take home items/single service items directly stored on the floor in dry storage areas.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER TO ENSURE ALL SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS ARE STORED AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR ONTO NSF APPROVED SHELVING UNITS OR DUNNAGE RACKS BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items Storage and Handling
violations.observation: Observed single service take out aluminum pans handled, displayed or dispensed with the food or lip-contact surface facing upward in the dry storage area of the main kitchen space.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items and cleaned/sanitized utensils shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of food and lip contact surfaces are prevented. EHS SHOWED THE STAFF MEMBER THAT THE ITEMS NEEDED TO BE TURNED UPSIDE DOWN. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION AND TRAINING TO STAFF BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Safe Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not safe: 1) OBSERVED A LARGE BLACK TRASH BAG USED TO STORE RAW BEEF INSIDE A TWO DOOR REFRIGERATOR IN THE BACK KITCHEN STORAGE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be safe. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER TO REMOVE THE RAW BEEF FROM THE GARBAGE BAG AND TRANSFER IT TO A PROPER FOOD CONTAINER. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Equip/Utensils, Durable under Normal Use
violations.observation: The following equipment is not identified as NSF approved or equivalent: 1) BOTH COLD NOODLE MACHINES, 2) COLD NOODLE SOUP MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment and utensils shall be designed and constructed to be durable and to retain their characteristic qualities under normal use conditions. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER TO PROVIDE A SPECIFICATION SHEET FOR THE KOREAN DESIGNED AND MANUFACTURED EQUIPMENT TO SHOW IT IS NSF APPROVED OR EQUIVALENT BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: 1) ICE MACHINES MISSING THE FRONT PANELING EXPOSING THE INTERIOR COMPONENTS.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER TO INSTALL THE PANELING BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: Observed no proper air gap on the sanitize basins for all the 3-vat sinks (in the kitchen, kitchen storage space, etc).
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch. EHS SHOWED THE STAFF MEMBER A PICTURE OF PROPER PLUMBING FOR A 3-VAT SINK. STAFF MEMBER WILL ENSURE A LICENSED PLUMBER COMES TO PROPERLY PLUMB THE SINKS BASED ON THE APPROVED DIAGRAM. MANAGER CALLED A LICENSED PLUMBER. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. Gogi Friends (Inspection Date: 04/02/2025) Page 3 of 7

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water line servicing the water filter and ice machine in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER TO CONTACT A LICENSED PLUMBER TO ENSURE ANY PIECES OF EQUIPMENT ATTACHED TO A WATER LINE (E.G. ICE MACHINE, COFFEE MACHINES, ETC) ARE EQUIPPED WITH PROPER BACK FLOW PREVENTION DEVICES. MANAGER CALLED A LICENSED PLUMBER FOR SERVICE. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed the kitchen area hand sink in the dish washing area not functional. The piping was disconnected and therefore staff cannot use the hand sink to wash hands.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER TO REPAIR THE DISH WASHING AREA HAND SINK BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Outside Receptacle, Tight Fitting Lids
violations.observation: Outside refuse and recycling bins have no lids and/or doors.
violations.corrective_action: Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered with tight fitting lids or doors if kept outside the food establishment. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER TO CONTACT THEIR WASTE DISPOSAL SERVICE AND GET NEW TRASH AND RECYCLING BINS THAT ARE EQUIPPED WITH LIDS AND DOORS BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Receptacles, Provided for Paper Towel Disposal
violations.observation: There is no refuse container at the area immediately adjacent to hand sinks.
violations.corrective_action: If disposable paper towels are used at handwashing sinks, a trash can shall be located at each sink or group of adjacent sinks. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER TO ENSURE ALL HAND SINKS HAVE TRASH CANS NEARBY FOR DISPOSAL OF DIRTY AND USED PAPER TOWELS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. Gogi Friends (Inspection Date: 04/02/2025) Page 5 of 7

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the following physical facilities are not maintained in good repair: 1) KITCHEN FLOOR TILES ARE IN NEED OF GROUTING, 2) HOLES IN WALLS NEED TO BE SEALED, 3) PANELING ON KITCHEN WALLS NEED TO BE SEALED, 4) SMALL GAPS/HOLES IN CEILING PANELS OR MISSING CEILING PANELS IN THE KITCHEN OR DRY STORAGE AREAS NEED REPLACING OR SEALING.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER TO REPAIR THE PHYSICAL FACILITIES TO ENSURE CLEANABLE SURFACES AND PREVENT POSSIBLE ENTRY OF INSECTS AND/OR RODENTS. ENSURE CORRECTION NO LATER THAN 30 DAYS.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the kitchen walls are in need of cleaning. Observed the kitchen walls and plumbing under 3-vat sinks and the dish machine are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER TO THOROUGHLY CLEAN KITCHEN WALLS AND PLUMBING BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Premises Free of Unnecessary Items/Equipment
violations.observation: Observed that items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment are being stored on the premises.
violations.corrective_action: Remove unnecessary items, including equipment which is no longer in use, from the premises to allow for regular and effective cleaning and to prevent harborage conditions. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER TO REMOVE ANY UNUSED EQUIPMENT FROM THE PREMISES BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP AS IT CONTRIBUTES TO HARBORAGE CONDITIONS FOR PESTS.

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER THAT USED MOPS SHALL BE CLEANED AND THEN HUNG TO ALLOW AIR DRYING. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF AND CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.
